resources.string: Warn about SMS from numbers known as spam. The app only shows a notification: it can\'t block or delete messages. Message texts are not stored or sent anywhere.
Also warn about messages with shortened links (bit.ly and similar) from unknown senders. The text is only checked on this device.
Without the SMS permission the app can\'t check message senders
Messages from senders known as spam
The message contains a link: don\'t open it
Unknown sender: be careful and don\'t open the link
The short link (%s) hides the real address
Messages from numbers known as spam get a warning. SMS can\'t be blocked: only the default SMS app can do that.
Allow the app to receive SMS, otherwise it can\'t warn about spam messages.
